36:28.text: And We sent not against his people after him a host from the heaven, nor was it needful for Us to send

36:30.text: Alas for mankind! There never came a Messenger to them but they used to mock at him.

36:31.text: Do they not see how many of the generations We have destroyed before them? Verily, they will not return to them.

36:32.text: And surely, all - everyone of them will be brought before Us.

36:33.text: And a sign for them is the dead land. We give it life, and We bring forth from it grains, so that they eat thereof.

36:34.text: And We have made therein gardens of date-palms and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein.

36:35.text: So that they may eat of the fruit thereof - and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks?

36:36.text: Glory be to Him Who has created all the pairs of that which the earth produces, as well as of their own
, and of that which they know not.

36:37.text: And a sign for them is the night. We withdraw therefrom the day, and behold, they are in darkness.

36:38.text: And the sun runs on its fixed course for a term
. That is the Decree of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.

36:39.text: And the moon, We have measured for it mansions
till it returns like the old dried curved date stalk.

36:40.text: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor does the night outstrip the day. They all float, each in an orbit.
